purpose: Route conversational intent to the least consequential workflow that safely satisfies the requested human goal.
rules: Infer task scope from the Professor's current goal, explicit constraints, environment and conversational corrections.
Do not escalate a development task into release, publication or Crown ceremony merely because those workflows exist.
Prefer the smallest reversible lane that can satisfy the request.
Ambiguity between two equally consequential safe lanes may require one concise clarification; otherwise proceed with the narrower lane.
A higher-authority lane is selected only when the requested outcome actually requires its boundary.

routingStrategy.rule: Attempt the highest workflow state justified by Professor intent and current evidence. On deterministic failure, stop advancement and fall back to the most recent evidence-backed known-good checkpoint.
